title: Felix 2007

pages.message: Hurricanes tend to form over the warm tropical oceans where the SST is warmer than ~26.5 C (~80 F)

These simple visualizations are plots of time vs. wind speed for each tropical storm/hurricane of Atlantic Hurricane seasons from 1950 to the present. Horizontal lines indicate wind speed category thresholds.

note: Ours: Grows across the Caribbean to category 5, comes ashore in Nicaragua at 140 kt and dies over land 18 hours later. The whole life of the storm (section 12). Chosen because every record of it over the sea is at or above 26.5 °C (MUR monthly SST; the coolest is 28.3 °C) and it dies on land after its last landfall (section 9.2).

sources.source: HURDAT2 Atlantic best track (NOAA National Hurricane Center)
sources.credit: Landsea, C. W. and J. L. Franklin, 2013: Atlantic Hurricane Database Uncertainty and Presentation of a New Database Format. Mon. Wea. Rev., 141, 3576-3592.
